cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
This *needs* to be a dict; if we pass it as the `from_dict` argument and it's `None`, then we are joining literal strings of `title` and `sub_title` 
```suggestion
            high_level = traverse_obj(initial_state, ('elecFullInfo', 'show_info', 'high_level', {dict})) or {}
```
